name: Independence Day
overview: Scripture reveals that true freedom is ultimately found in Christ, who liberates believers from the bondage of sin and death, as emphasized in John 8:36 and Romans 8:2. The call to proclaim liberty, such as the Jubilee year described in Leviticus 25:10, reflects God's design for restoration and rightful inheritance. Nations are blessed when they acknowledge the LORD as their God (Psalms 33:12), yet believers are reminded to maintain a heart of righteousness, avoiding rejoicing over the downfall of enemies (Proverbs 24:17). Even amid a world influenced by wickedness (Job 9:24), God's provision of spiritual freedom remains the believer's hope and foundation.
